_about: The Elven Village (a living village): its original creatures restored from the area files (circle-contrib-areas/elven) where ours lacked them: the elven soldiers and guardian, the mage, Quintor, the bartender, the Chief of the elven guard (a sub-boss) and the Champion. Villagers call the guard, and the guard and the rangers come; a ranger walks the forest path. The High Elven Guardian keeps the end of the fine path, the heart of the village, and the guard answers his horn.

11050.name: Elf Guardian Elven
11050.long_desc: An Elven Guardian is standing here guarding the portal.
11050.description: This is a robust built elf in his best years and as far as you can tell.

helpers.shout: An elven horn sounds through the trees: the guard is coming!

11051.name: Elf Soldier guard elven
11051.long_desc: An Elven Soldier is standing here guarding the path.
11051.description:
This is an elf in his youth, sent by the chief of the village guards, to
guard the path from any intruder not wanted here.

helpers.shout: An elven horn sounds through the trees: the guard is coming!

11052.name: Elf mage elven
11052.long_desc: A Tiny Elven mage is floating behind the counter.
11052.description: You notice a tired look on his face.

11053.name: Elf Quintor grocer
11053.long_desc: An Elf named Quintor is here counting money behind the counter.
11053.description: You notice a tired look on his face.

11054.name: elf bartender elven
11054.long_desc: A fat Elf is standing behind the bar taking orders.
11054.description: You notice a tired look on his face.

11055.name: elf chief elven guard
11055.short_desc: the Chief of the elven guard.
11055.long_desc: A lazy-looking Elf lies on his bed snoring loudly.
11055.description:
This elf looks somehow more experienced than any guard in the village
guard. By the look of the uniform he is probably the chief of the
village guard. You notice some scars on the hands and one on the neck of
the elf. He has obviously been in battle in his days.

helpers.shout: An elven horn sounds through the trees: the guard is coming!

11056.name: elf elven champion
11056.long_desc: An elven Champion is standing here looking at the trophies.
11056.description:
The elf in front of you is quite good looking and robust build (for an
elf). As far as you can see.

11057.name: high elven guardian elf
11057.long_desc: The High Elven Guardian stands motionless at the end of the path, a great silver bow in hand.
11057.description: Taller than any elf of the village, clad in mail of living silver leaves that shift with his breath, the High Elven Guardian has kept this forest for longer than Garathorm has had walls. His eyes are the green of deep leaves, and they miss nothing that moves among the trees.

helpers.shout: The High Elven Guardian sounds a silver horn: the whole guard of the forest answers!

patrols.why: a ranger walks the path through the forest

11090.room_desc: A tall longbow of pale silvered wood lies here.
11090.description: A longbow taller than a man, of pale wood that gleams like silver, strung with something finer than gut. It hums faintly when drawn.

11091.short_desc: a coat of living silver leaves
11091.room_desc: A coat of silver leaves lies here, stirring as if in a breeze.
11091.description: A coat of mail made of overlapping silver leaves, each one alive and shifting. It is lighter than cloth and turns blades like steel.

bosses.why: the High Elven Guardian at the end of the fine path, the heart of the village
